atoms.destination: Ready consumer contract + independent Character implementation

atoms.statement: Planner is independent of Ready and owns plan/progress management.
Learning Engine is independent of Ready; Ready is an execution consumer.
Learning Engine and Planner are sibling semantic services.
Ready/Hide/Snap consume multiple OS/domain services and return events/evidence.
The same ownership/consumption principle applies to Work OS, Learning OS, TAKY and future OS/domain systems.
A tree-only architecture is insufficient; TAKY requires ownership hierarchy plus interaction graph.
Think Again, Keep Your Key. and Think Again, You're The Key. are TAKY's paired slogans and core principles.
Think Again defines reasoning/search/verification conditions; Keep Your Key defines control/ownership; You're The Key defines human agency/accountability.
TAKY defines what to think, what to search, what evidence to trust, and what result to produce.
Hallucination/context loss/recreation must be blocked at root-cause level before output.
Implementation host/repository location must never imply semantic ownership.
Work OS requires the same semantic-owner vs implementation-host audit.
TAKY runtime/orchestrator layers require the same ownership audit.
Planner/Learning code extraction must wait until semantic ownership and contracts are frozen.
